scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @waypoint/shared build && pnpm db:generate && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web "pnpm --filter @waypoint/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @waypoint/api dev" "pnpm --filter @waypoint/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @waypoint/shared build && pnpm --filter @waypoint/ui build && pnpm --filter @waypoint/api build && pnpm --filter @waypoint/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @waypoint/shared build && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @waypoint/shared build && pnpm -r --if-present test
